scope_caveats: Scope inventory, not fresh code/CI review of every PR. Historical PR validation is not present release evidence.
Every conditional and deferred row is outside alpha.1/2; neither is a blanket exclusion from later v0.5.
Full native mypy #1322 is an issue, not a PR, and is outside the release commitment.
Async/core asyncio is deferred by default; inclusion would need a dedicated alpha and broader qualification.
Broad concurrency, libuv/process-worker research, collector experiments and native-wheel prototypes are outside commitment. Synchronous futures #1416 and gc API #1351 are distinct compatibility work.
NotImplemented #1472/#1249 need reconciliation. Bounded matching #1272 shipped, but that does not prove whole-head supersession of #1252.
Circular imports need a complete fix; #1420 readiness changes must not land alone. Related handler PRs do not prove the issue resolved.
Lean sum proof #1455 must precede loop optimization #1450. JIT O2 #1456 and application PGO #1444 are optional; compiler PGO prototype #1218 is separate.
Related importlib #1365, librt.base64 #1434 and upstream-consumer candidates require concrete selected workflows; no automatic scope expansion.
#1493 and its constructor/numeric boundary stack remain after the cleared alpha.2 candidate and deferred from these two releases.

integration_provenance.title: Prepare v0.5.0-alpha.1 correctness and verification
integration_provenance.body:
## Problem

Tuple comparisons and cross-module context managers have correctness gaps; expanded verification and performance tools need combined qualification.

## Change

Integrate #1293, #1440, #1443, #1470, #1339 and the Lean stack ending in #1429, preserving histories. Repair tuple dispatch, omitted None ABI arguments, checker/report provenance and benchmark deadlines. Correct nullable unbound calls, contextmanager metadata/reflection and super lookup order. Add alpha.1 version and notes. Codex assisted implementation and independent reviews. Fixes #1469; refs #1476.

## Validation

Final tree d41286e8 passes three-stage compiler/runtime fixed points (923418/21214 IR lines), lint/runtime contracts, 46 focused native GC JIT/AOT checks, all PR checks and fresh Codex review. Complete 4544-case IR comparison: zero new rejections, all changes explained. Full Lean census: 2529 programs, exact inventory/source/checker identities, zero failed inspections and no new shared-program unproved verdicts. Compiler-hidden contextmanager fields reduce modeled obligations; two new storage-model functions remain unsupported. Four-worker failures and validated two-worker resume are retained. One unchanged compile-limits CI retry passed. [Qualification evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/issues/1476#issuecomment-6871762073). Exact-main and distribution gates follow merge.
